title: Grilled Pork Nuong with Vietnamese Bun
description: A classic Vietnamese dish featuring grilled pork served with steamed bun and fresh herbs.

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder
ingredients.notes: marinated in fish sauce, lime juice, and sugar

instructions: 2. In a small bowl, whisk together fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, salt, and black pepper.
3. Add the pork shoulder to the marinade and coat evenly. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
4. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
5. Remove the pork from the marinade and grill for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
6. Let the pork rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
7. Steam the bun according to package instructions.
8. Assemble the dish by placing a few slices of pork on each bun, topping with chopped minari, and serving with a lime wedge and a sprinkle of cilantro.
